summary: Even a near-perfect model of the eval opponent (Gate A white-box <-> HeuristicAgent agreement 0.958) reaches only PARITY vs the heuristic at n=120 (search 0.500 vs base 0.483, delta +0.017 < +0.03). The n=40 +0.225 spike was base's unlucky low draw; the learned arm shows the same small-n inflation and is bounded above by white-box. Fifth independent mechanism to fail to compound on GREEN; the residual the search direction was retired on (opponent model) is now closed. Search/inference family exhausted on every axis (depth, aggregation, opponent-model quality).

whitebox.note: decisive upper bound -- perfect (heuristic) opponent model; h2h-vs-base is CONFOUNDED (models heuristic, plays base)

learned.note: GREEN-as-opponent; generalizable arm, bounded above by white-box (a less accurate model of the heuristic). n=40 shows the same base-low/search-high inflation as white-box n=40 -> parity by transitivity.

gate_c: not run -- Gate B AMBER; white-box upper bound is parity, so there is no stronger-than-base teacher to distill
